orig.name: Original formation heel
orig.audit: Reproduces the published 13n and 9.5n (exact slopes in our rebuild).

caption.X: The first construction (Algorithm 1). Four knights move as a 2×2 formation along parallel diagonal lines and turn around at the top and bottom edges with an 8-column heel. Each heel has 32 crossings, and each 4-row side piece has 10: 2·(32/8 + 10/4)·n = 13n.
caption.T: The first construction (Algorithm 1). Every edge square must turn. The formation heel has 22 turns per 8 columns on the top and bottom edges, and the side pieces 2 per row: 2·(22/8 + 2)·n = 9.5n.

paper.name: Parker Williams heel (crossings)
paper.audit: Reproduces the published 12n (exact slope in our rebuild; heel figure checked in Claim 21).

caption.X: Same layout, a better heel. Parker Williams's heel leaves the formation for a few moves and reaches the same exits with 28 crossings instead of 32: 2·(28/8 + 10/4)·n = 12n.

heel21.name: Parker Williams heel (turns)
heel21.audit: Reproduces the published 9.25n. We rebuilt the heel by an exact search (OPTIMAL: 21 turns, 31 crossings, as in the paper's Figure 11).

caption.T: Same layout, a heel with 21 turns per 8 columns, one fewer than the formation heel, with the same exits: 2·(21/8 + 2)·n = 9.25n.

P40.name: Shisheng Li 4×40 block
P40.audit: Reproduces the published 11.5n (exact slope in our rebuild).

caption.X: Shisheng Li replaced five heels (40 columns) with one 4×40 block that keeps the same exits and path pairs. The block has 130 crossings, not 5·28 = 140: 2·(130/40 + 10/4)·n = 11.5n.

H16a.name: H16a heel
H16a.audit: Audited: KT Verifier Claims 1, 4, 7 (all even n ≥ 48).

caption.X: We let the four knights come back in any order (Nil's idea) and fix the order in the 6×6 corners, which a computer search fills. The search then finds the heel H16a with 16 crossings per 8 columns: 2·(16/8 + 10/4)·n = 9n.

LF4.name: Lane-free LF4
LF4.audit: Audited: KT Verifier Claim 8 (all even n ≥ 96).

caption.X: No formation lanes at all. Each edge gets its own periodic piece, found by search, and the corners join them into one tour. Crossings per unit of edge: 11/6 bottom, 37/16 top, 2 left, 1 right. Total 343n/48 ≈ 7.15n.

FOLD.name: Fold design
FOLD.audit: Audited: KT Verifier Claim 12 (all even n ≥ 96).

caption.X: No lanes. The two diagonals and the two centre lines cut the board into 8 triangles. In each triangle all moves are parallel, and at the edges the tour folds back with U-turns: about 5n crossings. Each corner has one extra square of one color; a thin diagonal corridor carries it to the centre: 4n/3 more. Total 19n/3 ≈ 6.33n.

T18.name: T18 heel
T18.audit: Audited: KT Verifier Claims 3, 4 (lane rule, all even n ≥ 48).

caption.T: We let the four knights come back in any order inside their lane pairs and fix the order in the corners. The search then finds the heel T18 with 18 turns per 8 columns: 2·(18/8 + 2)·n = 8.5n.

TT16.name: TT16
TT16.audit: Audited: KT Verifier Claims 6, 7 (all even n ≥ 48).

caption.T: New pieces on all four edges. T16 makes 16 turns per 8 columns on the top and bottom, and new side pieces (2 turns per row) fit its line pairing: 8n − 14. Our lower bound is 8n − 28, so the leading term 8n is exact.
